postTitle: Hook Spotlight: Debug Your Custom Hooks with useDebugValue 🚀
postContent:
Hook debugging made simple.
useDebugValue attaches a label to a custom Hook in React DevTools.
It doesn’t affect what your component renders.
You pass a value from your hook as the first argument.
Optionally, pass a formatter as the second argument.
The formatter controls how the value looks in DevTools.
This makes complex hooks easier to understand when you inspect components.

tehnicalChallange.title: Challenge: Add a formatter to your hook and verify DevTools label
tehnicalChallange.description: Create a small hook that uses useDebugValue with a formatter function. Integrate it into a component and confirm the DevTools label shows the formatted result. Keep rendering unaffected.
